WEBSCALE: viewer web app (/watch) before / after

Production web export (EXPO_BASE_URL=/watch) served by the Dev World server. Before: the 10-foot shell scaled to the window width (scale = max(0.6, width / 1920)). After: fixed CSS px (scale 0.72 on the web), artwork and card counts follow the window, browser zoom zooms. Zoom is emulated like Chrome: CSS viewport = 1920 / zoom, deviceScaleFactor = zoom. Click a picture for the full-size file. "phys" = CSS px × device pixel ratio.
